title: Resource bounds enforcement (max hooks, max requests per hook)
user_story: As an operator, I need the server to enforce bounded resource usage so that the system doesn't grow unboundedly and exhaust disk space or memory.
description: Enforce two TigerBeetle-style resource bounds: (1) max_hooks — reject hook creation when the limit is reached, and (2) max_requests per hook — evict the oldest requests when a hook exceeds its request storage limit. Both limits come from Config. New database methods are needed: count_hooks() for the hook limit check, and delete_oldest_requests() for request eviction. The eviction strategy is 'circular buffer': when a new request arrives and the hook is at max_requests, the oldest request is deleted before inserting the new one.

acceptance_criteria.given: a server configured with --max-hooks 2 and 2 hooks already exist
acceptance_criteria.when: sending POST /api/hooks to create a third hook
acceptance_criteria.then: response is 409 with structured JSON error: 'hook limit reached (2/2)', suggestion to delete unused hooks or increase --max-hooks

acceptance_criteria.given: a server configured with --max-hooks 2 and only 1 hook exists
a server configured with --max-requests 3 and a hook with 3 stored requests
acceptance_criteria.then: the oldest request is evicted, the new request is stored, and the total remains at 3

acceptance_criteria.given: a server configured with --max-requests 3 and a hook with 1 stored request
acceptance_criteria.then: the new request is stored normally (no eviction), total becomes 2
the correct number of hooks is returned
only the oldest requests are deleted, newest are preserved, and the hook's request_count is updated
tests verify both limits with edge cases: at limit, over limit, zero hooks, single request eviction

functions.description: Count total hooks in the database for max_hooks enforcement

functions.signature: pub fn delete_oldest_requests(&self, hook_id: &str, keep: u32) -> Result<u32, AppError>
functions.description: Delete oldest requests for a hook, keeping only the newest 'keep' requests. Returns number deleted.

single_binary_checklist.notes: Resource bounds are the core TigerBeetle principle. Both limits configurable via CLI/TOML. Eviction is deterministic (oldest first by received_at).
